project: MedSAM Automatic Prompt Generation on KiTS23

historical_validation_reference.note: This is the highest historical validation case-volume mean, but it is not the final frozen robust operating point. V1a.3-B B1 is retained because it substantially improves all-slice Dice and negative specificity with nearly identical case-volume Dice.

secondary_evaluation.split: same 27-case split previously exposed earlier in the project

closed_followup_studies.V1a.4: Remote-satellite presence recovery increases recall without increasing presence FPR, but recovered-slice geometry prevents downstream case-volume improvement.
closed_followup_studies.V1a.5: Geometry copied or extrapolated from the distant dominant span fails because reliable anchors are 49-73 slices away.
closed_followup_studies.V1a.6: Satellite-local robust geometry improves prompt-level metrics but does not improve frozen-MedSAM segmentation.

preferred_next_phase: or a separately designed learned cross-slice geometry model with a new frozen protocol
